text.tspan: 1. hike the Valley Rim Trail to E Ledges of El Capitan descent
2. rappel the route with a single 70m rope.
No rappel stations can be skipped. All
rappel anchors have rings. A belay anchor has
rings if and only if it is also a rappel anchor.
3. rappel the route with two 70m ropes. Skip
rap stations above and below bivy terrace,
